a.text: I'll stick to our agreement and operate in round 1. Heads up: with an 80% storm chance each round, the plan is very risky for both of us. Still, I won't take early. If you want to change the plan, say so openly and we can agree on it together.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Operating as agreed. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
